senses.gloss: pr. n. m.Meïr, esp. R. M., a renowned Tannai, disciple of R. Akiba and of Elisha ben Abuya (v. Fr. Darkhe Mish., p. 154, a. אֱלִישָׁע).
units: <cite ref="Eruvin 13b:6">Erub. 13ᵇ</cite> <he>לא ר׳ מ׳ שמו אלא ר׳ מיישא שמו</he> (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) his name was not R. M. but R. Maysha.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 9:5">Gen. R. s. 9</cite>, a. fr. <he>בתורתו של ר׳ מ׳</he> in R. M.’s copy of the Pentateuch.
<cite ref="Mishnah Chullin 4:4">Ḥull. IV, 4</cite>; a. v. fr.
